description: Image Description: This image captures a vibrant urban scene at night, showcasing a bustling cityscape with a prominent elevated train station on the left. The station features a long, covered platform with a metal framework and a dark roof, illuminated by artificial lighting that highlights its structural details. Below the platform, a train is visible, partially lit, suggesting it is either arriving or departing. The station is adjacent to a roadway where light trails from moving vehicles create streaks of white and yellow, indicating long-exposure
